args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release healthy in production. Follow-up: investigate root cause in v2.3.1 before re-deploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was unhealthy in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now running it. A follow-up check shows the service healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged the on-call engineer. It says what happened, explains the rollback, and asks for the v2.3.1 problem to be found and fixed before anyone deploys it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
